prompt: Through the curved edge of a space-station window: Great Britain and Ireland below, amber city clusters joined by thin threads of motorway light, a faint green aurora over the thin blue atmosphere line. Across the Midlands and the South the clusters are going dark in a ragged wave, while London is still lit. Over the dark patches, small white points swell into orange blooms under the cloud. Long lens. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
